items.name: Salted Butterscotch Brownie
items.description: Full-bodied and chewy, our moreish brownie is layered with handmade butterscotch on top and in the centre, with natural sea salt exalting its salty-sweet finish.

items.name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
items.description: Crisp on the outside yet rich and dense on the inside, this gluten-free cake makes a great option as a chocolate cake with a unique texture!

items.name: Chocolate Pistachio Cake
items.description: Awfully Chocolate's Pistachio Cake: rich chocolate layers, creamy ganache, premium pistachios. Moist, indulgent, and heavenly. A perfect balance of flavors. A blissful treat!

items.name: The Opera House
items.description: The Opera House, its many layers reminded French patissiers of the circles of the grand Paris opera houses. Made with a soft almond joconde sponge, this is Place de l’Opera you’ve dreamed of and more: dark chocolate cake, chocolate ganache and coffee cream cheese, our Opera cake will make you sing!

items.name: White Chocolate Butterscotch Block
items.description: A unique combination of white chocolate and sweet-salty butterscotch with a dark chocolate swiss roll.

items.name: Nutella Tart
items.description: Indulgence comes in the form of our Nutella Tart. Generous amount of baked nutella layered on top of a dark chocolate cookie crust. This delicious combination of soft chocolate and crunchy tart is a must-have for any occasion!

items.name: Super Stacked Chocolate Cake
items.description: Inspired by the traditional Southeast Asian Lapis Cake, our best-seller is a richer and denser version of our signature All Chocolate Cake. Each cake layer is baked one at a time, so a completed Super Stacked cake with six layers of cake and six layers of fudge takes almost four hours to complete.

items.name: Chocolate Banana Cake (8 inch)
items.description: The true blue foodie knows the magic of fresh local banana! We only use local bananas like pisang mas or pisang rajah, bought from small farms, for our delicious Chocolate Banana Cake, which has two layers of fresh banana between layers of chocolate cake.

items.name: All Chocolate Cake (6 inch)
items.description:
The signature All Chocolate Cake. An everyday chocolate cake made with our own chocolate, with its unique dark roast flavour. This cake does not contain any cream, and its soft and moist cake layers are not too sweet, allowing the natural roast of the cocoa to shine through.
Wordings not provided.

items.name: Chocolate Rum & Cherry (6 inch)
items.description: We use only whole dark pitted cherries and soak them in rum to bring out their flavour. The cherries cover both layers of fudge, and cherry rum juice is also drizzled on the soft cake layers, enhancing the delicious combination of chocolate, rum & cherries.

items.name: Box of 6 – Assorted Truffles
items.description:
All six of our flavours are found in this gift box. You won’t find any sticky sweet candy fillings in here, just luxurious dark chocolate ganache and an assortment of premium all-natural ingredients.
~We will replace with another flavour if one is not available.

items.name: Box of 18 – Dark Chocolate Truffles
items.description: No doubt our best seller, the Dark Chocolate Truffle is made of 70% dark chocolate, using only the finest belgian chocolate.

items.name: Box of 18 – Assorted Truffles
items.description: All six flavours are found in the box set. The perfect one as a gift for someone special or self-indulgence. All-natural ingredients with no preservatives added, beautifully gift packed and with its freshness sealed in, also great for travel gifting or as souvenirs.

items.name: Box of 6 – Dark Chocolate Truffles

items.name: 6" Chocolate Tiramisu Cake
items.description: Friends will thank you for bringing The Chocolate Tiramisu Cake, one of Singapore's most popular party cake flavours! With soft and moist black cocoa cake layers, velvet mascarpone, Italian sponge fingers soaked in kahlua, all wrapped in luscious cocoa sabayon.

items.name: 6" Black Forest Cake
items.description: Impress with our favourite black forest cake done in Awfully Chocolate style, with sumptuously moist black cocoa cake , fresh cream and chocolate, and dark cherries soaked in kirsch!

items.name: 6" Salted Caramel Cake
items.description: Layers soft dark chocolate cake with bursts of salty-sweet caramel, all crowned with a luscious topping of fresh meringue.

items.name: 6" Praline Cake
items.description: Our decadent ensemble of dark chocolate cake, layered with hazelnut praline and light, crunchy feuilletine. Delicately crafted in an elegant design and adorned with dark chocolate shavings, this festive creation makes an incredible gift for many holiday parties!
